body:
1. The sequence diagram under the Architecture section shows `delete 1` but `delete` command does not exist. Use `delete-client` instead.
2. The UI component shows PersonListPanel but does not show the panels for bakery items and orders.
3. The sequence diagram under the Logic section shows `delete 1` instead of `delete-client 1`

## Additional v1.5 beta-test evidence

Verified against the released guides and JAR at commit `e449792e137b14dcb3017da2c688d2a71f677a25`. Suggested PE classification for these documentation discrepancies: `type.DocumentationBug`, `severity.Low`.

Both embedded sequence PNGs still show `delete 1`, although the adjacent prose and command names in their PlantUML sources use `delete-client 1`. The old command returns `Unknown command.` in v1.5.

The logic sequence source additionally shows `DeleteCommand -> Model : deletePerson(1)`. The actual model API takes a resolved `Person`, not an integer.

Evidence:
- [Architecture sequence image](https://github.com/AY2627S1-CS2103T-F14-3/tp/blob/v1.5/docs/images/ArchitectureSequenceDiagram.png)
- [Logic sequence image](https://github.com/AY2627S1-CS2103T-F14-3/tp/blob/v1.5/docs/images/DeleteSequenceDiagram.png)
- [Logic sequence PlantUML source](https://github.com/AY2627S1-CS2103T-F14-3/tp/blob/v1.5/docs/diagrams/DeleteSequenceDiagram.puml)

### Additional acceptance criteria

- [ ] Resolve the displayed index to a `Person` and label the model call `deletePerson(personToDelete)`, explaining where that variable comes from.
- [ ] Regenerate both sequence PNGs after correcting their PlantUML sources.
- [ ] Inspect the rendered DG to confirm both images use `delete-client 1` and the logic image shows the correct model parameter type.
- [ ] Retain the UI component-panel correction already listed above.

The two PNGs are independently editable; grouping them here is a maintenance choice, not a claim that all related PE reports must be duplicates.
